newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mayne slips on Optus float nerves.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mayne slips on Optus float nerves.

text.p: The shares Mayne Nickless Ltd fell significantly for the second straight session on Wednesday as investors worry about a potential delay in the float of Optus Communications, to which Mayne Nickless shareholders will receive entitlements, dealers said.
At 3.40 p.m. (0540 GMT), Mayne shares were 20 cents lower at A$8.26 late on Wednesday , after falling 22 cents on Tuesday.
"The only area of conjecture that could be affecting Mayne's share price is what level of entitlements Mayne shareholders will receive for the Optus float," a Sydney-based dealer said.
Mayne Nickless has said it intends to sell its 25 percent stake in Optus in the public floatation of that company which has been planned for later this year.

Dealers said the investors selling were concerned that the float could be delayed until 1997 because of an ongoing legal dispute between Seven Network Ltd and Optus' 46.5 percent owned pay television subsidiary, Optus Vision.
